name: @qa-guru/allure-notifications-monorepo
description: Allure report → messenger notifications. 6.0.* = TypeScript monorepo (CLI + builder). 5.0.* = Java jar under legacy/java (freeze 5.0.8); there is no 5.1 line.

scripts.validate:action: action-validator action.yml && action-validator .github/actions/assert-collage/action.yml && action-validator .github/workflows/action-e2e.yml && action-validator .github/workflows/example-native-cli.yml && action-validator .github/workflows/example-allure-plugin.yml && action-validator .github/workflows/example-marketplace.yml && action-validator examples/github-actions/cli-notify.yml && action-validator examples/github-actions/plugin-notify.yml && node scripts/validate-action-contract.mjs
scripts.allure:generate: rm -rf allure-report && allure generate allure-results --output allure-report
